blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pathology vision-language foundation models vary in performance across diseases and tasks, with no single model consistently performing best. The high cost of expert pathology annotation can also limit the labeled data available for task-specific adaptation. Combining complementary pretrained representations is a potential approach to these limitations, yet learning an effective fusion from few labeled examples remains challenging. We introduce Few-shot Fusion Foundation Models of Computational Pathology ( FFM-CP ), which is a framework that combines multiple pathology vision-language models in the few-shot learning setting. The framework first aligns heterogeneous representations using a closed-form Orthogonal Procrustes transformation estimated from corresponding support images. This alignment preserves within-model feature geometry without training an additional alignment network. Within the aligned space, a unified graph enables information exchange across backbones by jointly refining support-image features and visual and textual class prototypes. These refined representations support complementary text-prototype and case-retrieval branches that capture semantic class knowledge and within-class visual variation, respectively. Each branch learns to combine predictions from all ordered backbone pairs, allowing queries encoded by one model to draw on evidence represented by another. We evaluate three backbone combinations on six histopathology datasets at 4 4 , 8 8 , and 16 16 shots per class. FFM-CP achieves higher mean macro-F1 than the strongest individually adapted member of each fused set in 50 50 of 54 54 comparisons. These findings suggest that combining complementary pretrained representations can improve histopathological classification when annotations are limited.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Histopathology images are central to cancer diagnosis, grading, and
subtyping, but developing computational models for these tasks traditionally requires large collections of images annotated by expert pathologists. Such annotations are expensive, and they are particularly difficult to obtain for rare entities and institution-specific diagnostic problems. Pathology vision-language foundation models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative. By pretraining visual and text encoders on large image-text collections, these models learn reusable representations that can support zero-shot prediction and adaptation from only a small labeled support set [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .

blocks.en: The growing number of pathology VLMs, however, creates a new model-selection problem. Their pretraining images, text sources, objectives, architectures, and embedding dimensions differ substantially. Consequently, each model captures a different subset of diagnostically useful morphology and terminology. Recent benchmarks confirm that model rankings vary across tissues and tasks, with no single foundation model consistently dominating the others [ 7 ] . Selecting one backbone in advance therefore commits the downstream classifier to that model’s representational strengths and blind spots while potentially discarding complementary evidence available in other models.
blocks.zh: 然而,病理学VLM的不断增多造成了一个新的模型选择问题. 它们的预训图像、文本来源、目标、架构和嵌入维度差别很大。 因此,每个模型都捕捉不同子集的诊断实用形态和术语. 近期基准证实,模型的排名因组织和任务而异,没有单一的基础模型始终主宰其他的[7]. 因此,提前选择一个主干线,下游的分类人员将致力于该模型的代表性优势和盲点,同时可能放弃其他模型中现有的补充证据。

blocks.en: Existing studies address few-shot adaptation and multi-model fusion for computational pathology as separate problems. Few-shot methods tune prompts or lightweight adapters for a single pathology VLM [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] , while the other methods combine independent combine pretrained vision and text encoders [ 13 , 14 ] . Conversely, multi-foundation-model approaches fuse visual features, slide representations, or prediction logits [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . These methods are generally designed for downstream cohorts containing hundreds or thousands of labeled samples, or they rely on a separate large-scale distillation stage. This leaves an important setting unresolved: how can several intact pathology VLMs be combined when the only downstream datasets consist of K K labeled tiles per class?
blocks.zh: 现有研究将几发适应和计算病理的多模型结合作为单独问题处理。 很少镜头方法调制单病理学VLM[8,9,10,11,12]的提示器或轻量级适配器,而其他方法结合了独立预训视觉和文本编码器[13,14]. 反之,多基础-模型方法将视觉特征、幻灯片表示或预测对数[15、16、17]融为一体。 这些方法一般为下游组群设计,包含上百或上千个标签标本,或者依靠单独的大规模蒸馏阶段. 这留下了一个重要的设置未解决的问题:当唯一的下游数据集由每类K K 标记的瓦片组成时,如何将几个完好无损的病理VLM合并?

blocks.en: This setting presents three connected challenges. First, independent pathology-pretrained VLMs produce heterogeneous feature spaces. Their dimensions may differ, and even embeddings of the same dimension need not be directly comparable. Meaningful cross-model interaction therefore requires alignment estimated from a small support set. Second, the models should exchange class-specific evidence during adaptation. Aggregating predictions from independently adapted models does not allow support-image features or class prototypes to benefit from evidence represented by other backbones. Joint refinement would enable visual examples and textual class knowledge from different models to inform one another before prediction. Third, fusion should exploit both semantic class information and the visual variation among individual support examples. Moreover, the usefulness of these complementary sources can vary across backbones and tasks. Together, these challenges motivate a framework that aligns, jointly refines, and combines representations from multiple pathology VLMs in the few-shot learning setting.
blocks.zh: 这一背景提出了三项相互关联的挑战。 首先,独立的病理学预修的VLM产生不同的特征空间. 它们的维度可能不同,即使嵌入同样的维度也不一定可以直接比较. 因此,有意义的跨模式互动需要从一套小型支助中估算出一致性。 第二,模型应在适应期间交换特定类别的证据。 从独立改编的模型进行综合预测,无法使支持-图像特征或类原型从其他骨干代表的证据中受益. 联合改进将使不同模型的视觉实例和文字类知识在预测前相互通报。 第三,聚变应同时利用语义类信息以及个人支持实例之间的视觉差异。 此外,这些补充来源的用处可能因骨干和任务而异。 这些挑战共同激励着一个框架,这个框架将多种病理学的VLM在少许速成学习环境中的表述相配合,共同完善和结合.

blocks.en: We introduce FFM-CP , a support-set-driven framework for cross-backbone fusion of pathology VLMs. FFM-CP first uses a closed-form Orthogonal Procrustes transformation, estimated from corresponding support images, to map all model representations into a shared reference space while preserving their internal geometry. It then constructs a unified heterogeneous graph containing support images, visual class prototypes, and text prototypes from every model. Seven relation types propagate visual and semantic evidence within and across backbones. Finally, cross-backbone pair fusion evaluates all M 2 M^{2} ordered query-evidence combinations in two complementary branches: (1) a text-prototype branch transfers semantic class information, (2) a case-retrieval branch compares each query with its most relevant labeled examples and preserves intra-class variation. The foundation-model encoders remain frozen, and all task-specific components are learned using the few-shot support set alone.

Across the extensive experiments, FFM-CP outperforms the best individual model within the corresponding fusion set in 50 cases, demonstrating the benefits of cross-backbone fusion.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Vision-language foundation models for pathology. Contrastive image-text pretraining has been extended to histopathology [ 1 , 2 , 4 , 6 , 26 , 5 , 3 ] . These models typically comprise a visual encoder E v E_{v} and a text encoder E t E_{t} , which map H&E tiles and descriptions to representations z v z_{v} and z t z_{t} , respectively. Pretraining encourages high cosine similarity between paired image and text representations. In our framework, both encoders remain frozen during downstream adaptation.
blocks.zh: 病理学远景语基础模型. 相矛盾的图像文本预训已扩大到组织病理学[1,2,4,6,26,5,3]. 这些模型通常包括一个视觉编码器E v E_{v}和一个文本编码器E t E_{t},分别将H&E的瓷砖和描述映射到表达式z v z_{v}和z t z_{t}. Pretrain鼓励配对图像和文本表达的高度同位素相似. 在我们的架构中,两个编码器在下游适应时仍然冻结.

blocks.en: Despite this shared structure, their pretraining data, objectives, and architectures differ. Training corpora include medical social media posts [ 1 ] , transcribed educational videos [ 2 ] , article figure-caption pairs [ 3 ] , and non-public clinical cohorts [ 4 , 5 ] . Most models directly align paired tiles and captions. MUSK [ 5 ] first applies unified masked modeling to unpaired data comprising 50 50 million tiles and 10 9 10^{9} pathology-text tokens, then aligns the modalities. Text encoders range from generic CLIP-style Transformers to biomedical models informed by disease ontology [ 6 ] . Visual architectures and embedding dimensions also vary. These differences may contribute to task-dependent variation in model performance.

blocks.en: Complementary strengths of pathology foundation models. In a benchmark of 32 foundation models on 41 computational pathology tasks, Bareja et al. [7] report tissue-dependent variation in model rankings. Different models lead on brain and breast tumor classification, bladder and prostate subtyping, and lung tasks. Differences in model development may contribute to this variability. The morphological features and scales used for diagnosis and grading also differ across tumor types. Nottingham grading of breast carcinoma combines tubule formation, nuclear pleomorphism, and mitotic count [ 27 ] . Gleason/ISUP grading of prostate carcinoma focuses primarily on glandular architecture, including gland fusion, cribriform formation, and loss of discrete glands [ 28 ] . Lung adenocarcinoma subtype assesses the predominant growth pattern from the arrangement of tumor cells within tissue [ 29 ] . These pathological differences provide a plausible basis for performance variation across tissues, although they cannot alone explain model rankings within a given tissue. The complementary strengths of existing models therefore motivate combining multiple pathology FMs.
blocks.zh: 病理基础模型的补充优势. 在41个计算病理学任务32个基础模型的基准中,Bareja等人. [7] 报告模型排名中依赖组织的变化. 不同的模型引导大脑和乳腺肿瘤的分类,膀胱和前列腺亚型,以及肺部的任务. 模型开发方面的差异可能助长这种可变性。 用于诊断和分级的形态特征和尺度也因肿瘤类型而异。 乳腺癌的诺丁汉分级结合了输卵管的形成,核聚变,以及线粒体计数[27]. Gleason/ISUP 对前列腺癌的分级主要侧重于腺体结构,包括腺聚变,细胞形成,以及离散腺的丧失[28]. 肺癌亚型评估组织内肿瘤细胞排列的主要生长模式[29]. 这些病理差异为不同组织的性能变化提供了可信的依据,尽管它们不能单独解释某一组织内的模型排名. 因此,现有模型的互补优势促使多种病理调频相结合。

Cross-backbone alignment. As discussed in Section 3.1 , pathology FMs may differ in embedding dimension and coordinate system.
Their features therefore require alignment before computing cross-backbone similarities in the unified graph. FFM-CP uses Orthogonal Procrustes (OP) to map each model’s features into a shared reference space.
The semi-orthogonality constraint preserves norms and inner products, retaining the feature relationships learned during pretraining. OP admits a closed-form solution based on features extracted from the same support tiles.
This enables alignment using only the few-shot support set, without additional alignment data or iterative optimisation.

Unified knowledge graph. Our graph construction is inspired by GraphAdapter [ 22 ] , which refines textual prompt features using task-specific structural knowledge obtained by modeling inter-class relationships. We extend this idea to a unified graph that jointly refines support-image features and visual and textual class prototypes across the M M pathology VLMs. Histopathological diagnostic categories should not be viewed as unrelated labels. Tumor classifications are hierarchical by construction [ 31 ] . For example, histological grading in breast cancer provides an ordinal scale in which neighboring grades differ in degree rather than in kind [ 27 ] . Accordingly, adjacent or morphologically similar categories may share morphological pattern and can pose diagnostic challenges for pathologists [ 32 ] . These relationships motivate a unified graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒱 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) that connects representations within and across the M M backbones.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluated the proposed method on six public histopathology datasets: LungHist700 [ 33 ] ( C = 7 C=7 classes), HeidelbergSkin [ 34 ] ( C = 16 C=16 classes), Kather2016 [ 35 ] ( C = 8 C=8 classes), LubLung [ 36 ] ( C = 9 C=9 classes), BRACS [ 32 ] ( C = 7 C=7 classes), BACH [ 37 ] ( C = 4 C=4 classes). The datasets span four organs including lung, skin, colorectum and breast. Moreover, they cover tissue-type recognition (Kather2016, LubLung, HeidelbergSkin) and diagnostic subtyping (LungHist700, BRACS, BACH), with sizes ranging from 400 images to 129,364 tiles and class counts from 4 to 16. Detailed description is included in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了6个公共组织病理学数据集的拟议方法:LungHist700 [33] (C=7 C=7类),海德堡皮肤 [34] (C=16 C=16类),Kather2016 [35] (C=8 C=8类),LubLung [36] (C=9 C=9类),BRCS [32] (C=7 C=7类),BACH [37] (C=4 C=4类). 数据集涵盖四个器官,包括肺部、皮肤、内分泌和乳房。 此外,它们还覆盖组织型识别(Kather2016,LubLung,HeidelbergSkin)和诊断亚型(LungHist700,BRCS,BACH),尺寸从400张图像到129,364块瓦,等级计数从4到16. 详细描述见附录A.1。

blocks.en: Every dataset was divided into disjoint training, validation and test proportions. Given a shot count K K , we draw K K examples per class from the training partition, and min ⁡ ( K , 4 ) \min(K,4) examples per class from the validation partition, following standard practice for few-shot adaptation of vision-language models [ 22 ] . For BRACS, we used the officially released test set as the test partition without further modification. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced FFM-CP , a framework for few-shot computational pathology that combines multiple pretrained vision-language foundation models.
The framework aligns their embeddings using Orthogonal Procrustes and refines visual and semantic evidence through a unified graph.
It then fuses predictions from all ordered query-evidence backbone pairs in text-prototype and case-retrieval streams.
The visual and textual encoders remain frozen throughout adaptation.

框架用Orthogonal Procrustes来协调它们的嵌入,并通过一个统一的图表来完善视觉和语义证据.
然后,它从文本原型和案例检索流中的所有有序的查询-证据主干对中导出预测。
视觉编码器和文字编码器在整个适应过程中一直处于冻结状态.

blocks.en:
Across six histopathology datasets, three backbone combinations, and three shot settings, FFM-CP achieves higher mean macro-F1 than the strongest member of the corresponding fused set in 50 50 of 54 54 comparisons.
Mean gains across the six datasets and three combinations are 2.35 2.35 , 3.12 3.12 , and 3.73 3.73 percentage points at 4 4 , 8 8 , and 16 16 shots, respectively.
Ablations at sixteen shots favour Procrustes over zero-padding and MLP alignment.
Cross-backbone prediction pairs provide a modest benefit that varies across datasets.
These findings support combining complementary pretrained visual and textual representations for histopathological classification when labels are limited.

Limitations and Broader Impacts. The experiments focus on tile- and region-level classification with three backbone combinations.
Ablations are limited to one combination at sixteen shots, and fusion is not beneficial in every setting.
Future work should examine whole-slide classification, transfer across institutions, and the computational cost of retaining multiple encoders.
The framework may reduce reliance on task-specific annotations.
However, potential biases inherited from the pretrained models and performance differences across patient groups require evaluation before clinical use.
